hard_gates.name: repository-integrity

decision.rationale: Keep the immutable local Compose release for the Sunday local-R1 boundary because every clean live journey, restart, restore, rollback, T1 restoration, and repository gate passed. This does not promote the system to hosted production.
limitations: The release is reachable only on the development Mac through an internal-CA HTTPS origin.
The journey uses synthetic accounts and open demonstration material, not real professor or student data.
Deterministic generation is selected after the four-model product screen failed; no LLM answer-quality claim is made.
Professor fidelity, external usability, learning outcomes, true visual reasoning, durable hosting, and the sealed 10,000-case product evaluation remain unproven.
